# ankra_cluster_power_schedule (Resource)

A scheduled stop or start of a cluster: once at `run_at`, or repeatedly per `cron_expression` in `timezone`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster power-schedules create`, `update` and `delete`. Every attribute but `cluster_id` updates in place.

After a `once` schedule fires the platform disables it and clears `next_run_at`; the provider keeps the configured `enabled` in state for such a spent schedule, so it shows no diff. A spent schedule cannot be changed in place, because the platform refuses a `run_at` in the past: the plan fails until `run_at` is moved to the future, or the resource is replaced (`terraform apply -replace`) or removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_power_schedule" "evening_stop" {
  cluster_id      = data.ankra_cluster.staging.id
  action          = "stop"
  stop_mode       = "delete_resources"
  schedule_kind   = "cron"
  cron_expression = "0 19 * * 1-5"
  timezone        = "Europe/Stockholm"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_power_schedule" "morning_start" {
  cluster_id      = data.ankra_cluster.staging.id
  action          = "start"
  schedule_kind   = "cron"
  cron_expression = "0 7 * * 1-5"
  timezone        = "Europe/Stockholm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `stop` or `start`.
- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `schedule_kind` (String) `once` (fires at `run_at`) or `cron` (fires per `cron_expression`).

### Optional

- `accept_node_local_data_loss` (Boolean) Acknowledges that an enabled `scale_to_zero` stop empties the volumes kept on worker disks; the platform refuses such a stop on a cluster with them without it. Sent with every write, never read back. Defaults to `false`.
- `cron_expression` (String) Five-field cron expression of a `cron` schedule, evaluated in `timezone`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule fires. Defaults to `true`.
- `preserve_state` (Boolean) Whether a `delete_resources` stop captures the cluster's state for the next start to restore, where the provider supports it. Defaults to `true`.
- `run_at` (String) RFC 3339 time a `once` schedule fires; must be in the future when written.
- `stop_mode` (String) How a stop stops the cluster: `delete_resources`, `scale_to_zero` or `pause`. Defaults to `delete_resources`, the only value a start schedule accepts.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone a `cron` schedule is evaluated in. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the schedule.
- `last_run_at` (String) When the schedule last fired.
- `last_run_status` (String) Outcome of the last run: `completed`, `skipped`, `deferred` or `failed`.
- `next_run_at` (String) When the schedule next fires; null while disabled or spent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Schedules are imported by cluster id and schedule id.
terraform import ankra_cluster_power_schedule.evening_stop 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666/3e5b7c9d-1f2a-4b6c-8d0e-a1b2c3d4e5f6
```
